name: put-my-page-online
description: Check your web page, then put it online as a free public link.
shortDescription: Check a page, share a link
longDescription: Paste the HTML (or a script or SVG file) of a page your agent built, with its file name, and get the verdict of the Pages publish check in plain words: what to fix, using the same rules the publish applies. It can also explain how to put a page online for free as a public link on pages.flisk.si: the steps, the one command and what the link looks like. Free, no account, no key. It only checks: nothing is published or stored here.
